name: Gem
tagline: AI-first all-in-one recruiting platform — ATS, CRM, sourcing, and outreach.
description: Gem is an AI-first recruiting platform that combines applicant tracking, candidate CRM, sourcing, scheduling, and analytics in one system. Its AI agents source across 800M+ profiles with natural-language queries, summarize candidates, and automate personalized outreach. It is used by over 1,200 companies including Airbnb, DoorDash, and Zillow.
insight: Hit unicorn status with a $100M Series C in Sept 2021 led by ICONIQ at a $1.2B valuation ($148M raised total).
edge: Consolidates ATS, CRM, sourcing, and outreach in one AI platform, with a Chrome extension that sources from LinkedIn and 800M+ profiles.
cons: No free tier; paid plans only
Geared to recruiting teams, not solos

references.title: Gem Raises $100M Series C, Solidifies Unicorn Status
